title: Enable Mark as Watched in all the other playlist fragments.

timeline.message: Enable Mark as Watched in all the other playlist fragments.
timeline.author: Nathan Schulzke

timeline.body: #### What is it? - [ ] Bugfix (user facing) - [X] Feature (user facing) - [ ] Codebase improvement (dev facing) - [ ] Meta improvement to the project (dev facing) #### Description of the changes in your PR - Enable "Mark as Watched" in all the non-feed fragments #### Before/After Screenshots/Screen Record - Before: - After: #### Fixes the following issue(s) - Fixes #7159 #### APK testing The APK can be found by going to the "Checks" tab below the title. On the left pane, click on "CI", scroll down to "artifacts" and click "app" to download the zip file which contains the debug APK of this PR. #### Due diligence - [X] I read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/blob/HEAD/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md).

Just a note: while testing this, I found that when I tapped "Mark as Watched" in several of the fragments, it did not immediately update. These same fragments also do not immediately update their visual status when you watch a video the regular way, so I didn't attempt to fix the reactivity in this pull request.

This code should definitely be deduplicated. I'd create a static method `shouldAddMarkAsWatched(StreamType)` to `StreamDialogEntry` that replaces all of these lines and is also used in `FeedFragment`.

reply.body: Fair enough, that's done. I had to pass the context in as well to get `isWatchHistoryEnabled` working.
Yeah, I didn't think to look for an `upsert` method the first time. XD
